findings.evidence: The pre-existing missing-effect discriminator traced acceptance directly to consumer recovery/effect state. RabbitMQ 4.2 permits positive publisher confirms for unroutable messages; mandatory publication returns them before the confirm.
findings.consequence: A confirm-only success log could redirect investigation toward premature consumer acknowledgement before establishing that a queue received the publication.
findings.correction: Trace routing/delivery explicitly; inspect incident-time exchange/key/bindings, alternate routing and correlated returns/confirms. Absent return logs with disabled mandatory/capture are not routing proof; current topology does not prove an earlier route.
